bio.text: Gwen Moore was elected in 2004 to represent Wisconsin's 4th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, and was the first African American elected to Congress from Wisconsin.
Before Congress she served in the Wisconsin State Assembly from 1989 to 1992 and in the Wisconsin State Senate from 1993 to 2004.
She was born in Racine in 1951, was raised in Milwaukee, and earned a B.A. in political science from Marquette University.
